title: Aptamer inhibits P-glycoprotein efflux function via the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Yujuan; Liu, Yujiao; Wu, Aijia; Liu, Huayan; Liang, Min; Pan, Qiuxia; Cheng, Dongsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA适配体抑制P-糖蛋白外排功能，涉及Wnt/β-catenin信号通路及分子对接，但核心是适配体-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA转录结合，且方法以实验为主、对接分析较浅，与课题关联有限。
abstract: Inhibiting permeability glycoprotein (P-gp) efflux is a strategy to enhance drug efficacy or overcome multidrug resistance in tumors. However, whether P-gp aptamer (APT(P-gp), an 81 bp ssDNA) inhibits P-gp efflux is unknown. Increased Rho123 uptake was observed in the rat brain and intestine. Bidirectional transport of Rho123 indicated that 100 nM of APT(P-gp) inhibited P-gp activity with inhibition ratios of 75.0 % in Caco-2 and 60.5 % in hCMEC/D3 cells. The apparent permeability coefficients (P(app)) from the apical (AP) to basolateral (BL) sides significantly increased by 129.4 % in Caco-2 and 8.0 % in hCMEC/D3 cells, respectively. The P(app) from the BL-->AP sides in the two cell lines decreased. P-gp mRNA and protein expression in the rat ileum, brain, and two cell lines markedly decreased following APT(P-gp) exposure. APT(P-gp) downregulated Wnt3, pho-Dvl2, beta-catenin expression and decreased the ratio of pho-GSK-3beta to GSK-3beta in the rat ileum and brain. Molecular docking analysis suggested that APT(P-gp) interact with Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway proteins at various amino acid sites. The present study reports a novel a novel nucleic acid-based P-gp inhibitor, which may benefit for enhancing drug efficacy or overcome multidrug resistance in clinical application.
abstract_zh: 抑制通透性糖蛋白（P-gp）外排是增强药物疗效或克服肿瘤多药耐药性的一种策略。然而，P-gp适体（APT(P-gp)，一种81 bp的单链DNA）是否抑制P-gp外排尚不清楚。在大鼠脑和肠道中观察到Rho123摄取增加。Rho123的双向转运表明，100 nM的APT(P-gp)抑制了P-gp活性，在Caco-2细胞中抑制率为75.0%，在hCMEC/D3细胞中为60.5%。表观渗透系数（P(app)）从顶端（AP）到基底外侧（BL）方向显著增加，在Caco-2细胞中增加129.4%，在hCMEC/D3细胞中增加8.0%。两种细胞系中从BL到AP方向的P(app)均下降。暴露于APT(P-gp)后，大鼠回肠、脑及两种细胞系中的P-gp mRNA和蛋白表达显著降低。APT(P-gp)下调了大鼠回肠和脑中Wnt3、pho-Dvl2、β-catenin的表达，并降低了pho-GSK-3β与GSK-3β的比值。分子对接分析表明，APT(P-gp)与Wnt/β-catenin信号通路蛋白在不同氨基酸位点发生相互作用。本研究报道了一种新型基于核酸的P-gp抑制剂，可能有助于在临床应用中增强药物疗效或克服多药耐药性。
